description: Close a pull request without merging it; its branch is not deleted. The comment, if any, is posted as it closes, and the people following the pull request are notified. A pull request that is closed or merged already is left as it is: nothing is sent, the comment is not posted, changed is false and state says which. A pull request is 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL; a bare number means the working tree's repository, or repo.

comment.description: A comment to post as the pull request closes.

pr.description: The pull request, as 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL.

repo.description: owner/name; defaults to the working tree's repository (its origin). Used for a bare number.

name: github_pr_close

changed.description: False when the pull request was closed or merged already and nothing was sent.

state.description: closed, or merged for a pull request that was merged already.

title: Close a GitHub pull request
